sn55.43:1.3: idha bhikkhave, ariyasāvako buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti:
sn55.43:1.4: “itipi so bhagavā …pe… satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā”ti.
sn55.43:3.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, ariyasāvako paññavā hoti, udayatthagāminiyā paññāya samannāgato hoti ariyāya nibbedhitāya sammādukkhakkhayagāminiyā.
sn55.43:3.3: ime kho bhikkhave, cattāro puññābhisandā kusalābhisandā sukhassāhārā.
sn55.43:4.1: imehi kho bhikkhave, catūhi puññābhisandehi kusalābhisandehi samannāgatassa ariyasāvakassa na sukaraṃ puññassa pamāṇaṃ gaṇetuṃ
sn55.43:4.3: atha kho “asaṅkheyyo appameyyo mahāpuññakkhandho”tveva saṅkhaṃ gacchatīti.
